sloka: अकृतात्मानमासाद्य राजानमनये रतम् ।समृद्धानि विनश्यन्ति राष्ट्राणि नगराणि च ।। ५.१९.१०।।।।
transliteration: akṛtātmānamāsādya rājānamanaye ratam ।samṛddhāni vinaśyanti rāṣṭrāṇi nagarāṇi ca ।। 5.19.10।।।।

translations.english: Though born in a traditional righteous and virtuous family, she was as though passing through a purificatory process like a lowbred woman.
